title: Container logs
prompt: Run a process that prints output, then inspect logs and exit status. Use only a disposable local/test environment and synthetic data; never submit secrets, production output, or personal information.

starter.content: docker run --name codeleaf-logs alpine:3.22 sh -c "echo lab-start; exit 0"

expected_output: Logs explain what ran and whether the main process succeeded.
acceptance_criteria: Logs explain what ran and whether the main process succeeded.
Record the exact commands/configuration and the Docker/Compose/Buildx version used.
Capture expected and actual output or a human-reviewed artifact; explain one failure/edge case.
Use only an isolated lab, authorized image/registry, and synthetic data; document cleanup and rollback.
hints: Start with the smallest reproducible lab and read the current official documentation for your installed version.
Inspect current state before making a change; use an explicit disposable resource name.
A text submission check does not execute Docker. Include test evidence and request human review where execution is required.
grading_method: Server-side required-string check on the learner submission only. It does not execute Docker/Compose, verify a live service, or prove the artifact is secure; the runtime result must be inspected in the learner’s local lab and reviewed against the acceptance criteria.
retry_policy: Allow retries after feedback. The platform awards XP only through its existing verified, idempotent activity rules; this file does not override XP.
status_note: Draft practice brief traced to Section C of Docker.pdf; verify practical behavior in an isolated Docker environment before publication.
